NOT_OUR_REALIZED_PROFIT: a counterfactual modification of another trader's public activity. Not shadow, not submitted, not filled, not settled, never realized.

metric_definitions.matched_retained_usd: sum over events of matched_shares * (1 - pair_cost), where matched_shares = min(up, down) of the fills THIS CELL took and pair_cost = VWAP_up + VWAP_down of those same fills, ex fee. Reconciles to the frozen audit's matched component on BASELINE.
metric_definitions.residual_pnl_usd: sum over events of (settlement payout on the retained residual) - (VWAP cost of the retained residual), where payout = |residual| if the residual side is the event's resolved winner else 0. The winner is the outcomeIndex of the event's REDEEM record, a resolver validated at median |redeem cash - modelled payout| = $0.0000 and exact on 89.2% of 2,000 resolved events. SCORING ONLY -- never visible to a rule.
metric_definitions.residual_loss_avoided_usd: residual_pnl_usd(cell) - residual_pnl_usd(BASELINE). Positive means the cell kept less of the losing residual.
metric_definitions.fees_usd: sum of max(0, usdcSize - price*size) over the fills THIS CELL took: the CHARGED wedge, never the 0.07*p*(1-p) formula.
metric_definitions.net_cash_ex_incentives_usd: matched_retained_usd + residual_pnl_usd - fees_usd. Rebates and rewards are exactly $0 by construction, as in protocol 3fb8fccb.
metric_definitions.turnover_retained_usd: sum of usdcSize over the fills THIS CELL took.
metric_definitions.events_touched: events in which this cell took at least one fill.
metric_definitions.events_per_observed_day: events_touched / 22 observed days. Observed days only -- the May-July coverage hole is a hole, not a zero, and no figure here divides by calendar span.
metric_definitions.worst_drawdown_usd: most negative (cumulative net - running peak) over events ordered by first-fill timestamp, using the cell's own per-event net.
metric_definitions.suppressed_action_frac: 1 - (fills taken / fills available). The fraction of original L5 actions this cell refused.
metric_definitions.suppressed_extend_frac: fraction of the available EXTEND fills this cell refused.
metric_definitions.suppressed_complete_frac: fraction of the available COMPLETE fills this cell refused.
metric_definitions.net_bp_of_turnover: 10000 * net_cash_ex_incentives_usd / turnover_retained_usd. Reported so a cell cannot look good merely by trading less.

strata_definitions.REGIME_PRE_2026-04-25: primary regime partition from analysis/l5/CANON_REGIMES.md change points ['2026-04-25','2026-06-23','2026-08-19']
strata_definitions.SETTLEMENT_RESOLVED: the 2,000 events carrying a REDEEM record, so the residual's settlement outcome is source-backed
strata_definitions.SETTLEMENT_UNRESOLVED: the 218 events with NO REDEEM record. Residual payout is scored $0 there, which is what the feed shows; 212 of the 218 are one-sided, so $0 is the correct outcome for a lost one-sided bet. The other 6 carry 1,829.86 matched shares whose complete-set redemption of $1,829.86 is GUARANTEED and ABSENT from the feed. Reported separately, never silently pooled.

no_hindsight_clause: A rule may read only ALLOWED_STATE_FIELDS, evaluated at the candidate fill's own timestamp, built from fills the cell itself already took. Settlement, redemption, event aggregates and any later fill are structurally unavailable to it. Thresholds were placed on state-distribution percentiles before any P&L existed and are frozen by the fingerprint below; no threshold is tuned on an outcome.
oos_hold_clause: No out-of-sample test is run under this spec. The split is NAMED and LEFT UNRUN in FRONTIER.md.
